singleSourced.context: The Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 got off to an outstanding start, selling over five million copies (approx 5.2 million units) in just four days.

singleSourced.key: ocarina of time for switch 2 is this year s
singleSourced.value: , Ocarina of Time for Switch 2 is this year's
singleSourced.context: As highlighted by Circana's senior director and video game industry advisor Mat Piscatella (via social media), "after just one week", Ocarina of Time for Switch 2 is this year's "best-selling physical video game in the US".
However, there is one technicality - Circana tracks and reports "code-in-box" sales as "new physical video game sales", so Zelda may not actually keep the crown.

singleSourced.context: The reaction from those I know who played for the first time and enjoyed it has generally been "yes, it really is one of the greats." What there's been less of, however, is a concerted effort to explain what exactly makes it deserving of that praise.
Arrows make up 32% of my consumable item use with Deku Seeds stalling behind at 30%, so this one's a bit different for my case.

singleSourced.context: And if anyone's wondering I last played through the N64 one like four, five months ago, it most certainly still holds up to me and it isn't some, "You're just saying that because it's been a long time since you've played it," nonsense, I genuinely prefer it.
Playing OoT made me realize that Hidetaka Miyazaki wasn't exaggerating when he said this is "the textbook for 3D games".
